title: Hold a licence to deal in protected animals or plants
what: Buy, sell or otherwise deal in protected or threatened animals or plants only as a biodiversity conservation licence authorises (or another defence in the Act applies).

sources.title: Biodiversity Conservation Act 2016 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person who deals in or attempts to deal in— (a) an animal or plant that is of a threatened species, or (b) an animal or plant that is part of a threatened ecological community, or (c) a protected animal or protected plant, is guilty of an offence

sources.title: Biodiversity Conservation Act 2016 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: a person deals in animals or plants if the person— (a) buys or sells the animals or plants

sources.title: Biodiversity Conservation Act 2016 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: It is a defence to a prosecution for an offence under Division 1 if the person charged establishes that the act that constitutes the offence was authorised by, and done in accordance with, a biodiversity conservation licence under Division 3

sources.title: Biodiversity Conservation Act 2016 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.locator: s 2.11, words naming the body (found 20 Nov 2026) (version of 2025-02-28)
sources.quote: The Environment Agency Head may grant a licence (a biodiversity conservation licence) to a person that authorises the doing of an act that would otherwise constitute an offence under Division 1 or under any other provision of this Act.
